title: Project purpose and requirement boundaries
description: Compare the current overview and agent handoff with the French specification. Treat requirements, milestones, and measured results separately.

title: The frontend entry point
description: The French root layout loads the shared design system, fonts, route content, and keyboard skip navigation.

title: Trusted sessions before private pages
description: Follow server-managed Supabase authentication and cookie refresh. No browser localStorage token is used for account identity.

title: The independent API identity boundary
description: FastAPI validates each bearer through Supabase, then applies the verified UUID to transaction-local database context.

title: Private database schema and immutable diagnostics
description: Read the migration for ownership roles, RLS, foreign keys, publication guards, and restricted score writes. The schema alone does not implement diagnostic APIs.

title: The current diagnostic runs locally
description: Trace language selection, answers, review, client-side score, and validated localStorage drafts. These answers are not yet saved on the account.

title: Behavioral evidence in browser tests
description: Review the real local registration, profile, session, recovery, diagnostic and responsive regression tests; static analysis does not rerun them.

title: The remaining backend milestones
description: Persistent diagnostics and the first source-grounded tutor loop remain future work. The roadmap records decisions and acceptance checks still needed.
